snippet.text: (hp : 0 < p) (hcone : |q| ≤ r * p) (h11 : |e11| ≤ eps) (h12 : |e12| ≤ eps) (hd : |damping - referenceDamping| ≤ δ) : |(lam - damping + e11) * p + e12 * q - (lam - referenceDamping) * p| ≤ (δ + eps * (1 + r)) * p; its proof rewrites the left side as |(referenceDamping - damping + e11) * p + e12 * q| (line 351), which is |-(d - d_ref) + E₁₁ + E₁₂ (q/p)| * p
